Placeholders Guide
fields.options:
Available Lead Placeholders for Prompt:

  • {{ lead_name }}: Full name of the lead
  • {{ first_name }}: First name
  • {{ company_name }}: Organization / Law Firm name
  • {{ job_title }}: Job Title / Designation
  • {{ email_id }}: Lead's email address
  • {{ phone }} / {{ mobile_no }}: Contact number
  • {{ industry }}: Industry category
  • {{ territory }}: Region / Jurisdiction
  • {{ qualification_status }}: Lead status
  • {{ notes }}: Custom background or meeting notes

The AI Gateway uses these fields to personalize the context, company pain points, and legal service solutions.
